evidence_notes: GPT-6 Astra as a frozen optimizer that writes the full parameter vector of fixed quantum circuits is the whole paper (p.2-4); the target is a quantum circuit, not a neural network. It returns numeric vectors with a first proposal without feedback and optional energy feedback afterwards (p.3-4, p.6), so direct_values and both protocols; largest stated size is p = 3n(L+1) with n = 12, L = n, i.e. 468 (p.7; LiH count not stated). No preregistration or AI-authorship statement found; code at github.com/tiago939/NeuralOptimizer (p.11); LLM inference cost explicitly excluded (p.7).
